verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no WorkOS feature for bulk-exporting your own users, organizations, connections or other data in open formats in order to leave. The migration docs cover importing data into WorkOS from Auth0, not exporting out of it. Audit-log export is a compliance feature for one data class, and API, OpenAPI or MCP read access is only a building block. A community member asked how to get login data out of WorkOS, and the pack has no documented answer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
